_doc: The dash's growth (the owner, 8 Nov: 'just pushing the button leveling it up is weird'): named, visible steps, each granted by the design lead's route (a lamp-post Wick or a level-up) through Journey.GrantDashStep. kind: charge (+amount pips, at most 2 from steps), length (the dash goes amount farther), recharge (charges come back amount sooner), landing (every dash ends in a shove), facet (the dash form's facet, the only way a movement art's facets now come). most: times it may be taken (1 if unset). Loaded by logic/Content/DashSteps.cs; checked by tests/DashStepTests.cs.

steps.name: Another Breath
steps.card: One more dash before you must catch your breath.

steps.name: Hard Landing
steps.card: Every dash ends in a shove: lesser things within 2 m are knocked aside.

steps.name: Iron Hide
steps.card: The barrier is 30% of your health.

steps.name: Pile Driver
steps.card: The charge ends in a slam that stuns everything 3 m round.

steps.name: Unbroken
steps.card: Each thing you strike adds 2% of your health to the barrier.

steps.name: Gore
steps.card: What you strike bleeds, and champions take half again as much.
